title: Women’s Suffrage National Monument Location Act
official_summary:
Women's Suffrage National Monument Location Act

This act authorizes the location of a monument on the National Mall to commemorate the women's suffrage movement and the passage of the 19th Amendment to the Constitution.

summary.headline: Law allows a monument honoring the women's suffrage movement and the 19th Amendment to be placed on the National Mall.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives permission for a monument honoring the women's suffrage movement and the passage of the 19th Amendment, which guaranteed women the right to vote, to be located on the National Mall in Washington, D.C.
